title: Quandra
tagline: QuandraSWAP is a Uniswap V2 deployed on Scroll Sepolia using Uniswap V2 contracts
description:
QuandraSWAP is a Uniswap V2 deployed on Scroll Sepolia using Uniswap V2 contracts

The project is built by forking uniswap v2 core and periphery contracts
The contracts are deployed with hardhat
The front-end is forked from https://github.com/Ben-Haslam/Alternative-Uniswap-Interface
